title: Instruction
description: One unit of work for a stateless executor.

attempt.description: 1 for the first dispatch; a retry after an infrastructure failure increments it.

conveyor_base_url.description: In-cluster address of the conveyor API the executor calls.

correlation_id.description: Groups the attempts of one logical request for tracing.

deadline_unix_ms.description:
Wall-clock deadline as Unix milliseconds. The pod's `activeDeadlineSeconds` is derived from
it; the token expires with it.

inputs.description: Inputs the executor may fetch through `GET /api/jobs/{id}/inputs/{name}`.

job_id.description: The conveyor job this attempt executes.

limits.description: Resource and size caps. The Job spec is built from these, not from a per-kind default.

outputs.description: The **closed** set of artefacts the executor may produce.

params.description:
Kind-versioned parameters. The executor validates its own shape; this contract does not
pretend to know every kind's vocabulary.

schema.description: Always [`CONTRACT`]; a different tag is refused rather than version-negotiated.

tenant.description: The tenant the job belongs to. Every byte route re-checks it against the job row.

trace_id.description: Trace identifier for logs and events.

Input.description: One input document the executor may fetch.

document_id.description: The document row the bytes belong to; the route resolves it and re-checks the tenant.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bytes, hex. The executor may refuse early when a download does not match.

Limits.description: Caps carried into the Job spec.

max_output_bytes.description: The sum of every declared output's size is checked against this.

wall_secs.description: Wall-clock cap in seconds. `activeDeadlineSeconds` on the Job.

Output.description: One artefact the executor may produce.

content_type.description: The executor must echo this exact type; a different one is refused by the route.

max_bytes.description: The largest acceptable body for this artefact.
